fusions.name: Javelin Hail
fusions.desc: Throws 2 javelins in a narrow spread, each dealing 5 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Plunging Point
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Also deals 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Thrown True
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a javelin strikes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
